fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x44D530 (VMInventoryRegistrationSystem::Update): clears the set when its key count (+0x2C) is non-zero (line ~179), then after VMInventoryDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(entity) inserts the entity with the HashSet<EntityHandle> insert FUN_1800f88d0 (line ~1064). HashSet = StaticArray<int32> buckets +0, Array<int32> NextIds +0x10, Array<key> Keys +0x20; live samples: bucket count at +8, cap/size pairs at +0x18/+0x28. Samples always show an empty key array (size 0), consistent with a per-frame 'newly registered' set.

summary: Client UI registry: the inventory entities whose view-model was created in this frame (the set is cleared at the start of each update, then filled after CreateVM). Singleton, lives from game start.
open_questions: Shape established from the Toolkit's system code and live samples; the bg3.exe creator was not read for this one (registry size 48 matches).
